result.instructions: Tools for Ticimax, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders from the last 7 days are paid but not yet shipped?"; "How many products in my store are out of stock?"; "Show the stock and price of the product with barcode 8690000000001.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ticimax data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ticimax_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ticimax_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ticimax_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ticimax_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ticimax_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List or search the store's orders, newest first: customer, totals, status, payment status, shipping company and tracking number, delivery and invoice address. Filter by status, payment status/type, customer (member id or phone), order number, invoice or tracking number, and creation or update date. Line items and payments are only included when asked for (include_items / include_payments; they make replies much larger, so use a small limit). SOAP SiparisServis.SelectSiparis.

order_id.description: Only the order with this internal order id (ID in the replies).

order_number.description: Only the order with this order number (SiparisNo).

order_status.description: Order status, e.g. Onaylandi (approved), Paketleniyor (packing), KargoyaVerildi (shipped), TeslimEdildi (delivered), Iptal (cancelled), Iade (returned). See ticimax_list_order_statuses.

payment_type.description: Payment type id (0 credit card, 1 bank transfer, 2 cash on delivery... see ticimax_list_payment_types).

member_id.description: Only orders of this member (customer) id (see ticimax_list_members).

phone.description: Only orders of the member with this phone number.

invoice_number.description: Only the order with this invoice number.

tracking_number.description: Only the order with this shipping tracking number.

created_from.description: Orders placed on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss, store time).

created_to.description: Orders placed up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

updated_from.description: Orders edited on or after this date.

updated_to.description: Orders edited up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

include_items.description: Include each order's line items (default false).

include_cancelled.description: Also include cancelled line items (default true, as in the vendor example).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset for the next page.

tools.name: ticimax_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by its internal order id, with line items, payments, shipping and invoice details. SOAP SiparisServis.SelectSiparis (filtered to one id).

tools.name: ticimax_list_order_items
tools.title: List order line items
tools.description: The line items of one order: product, stock code, barcode, quantity, price, VAT, status and shipping tracking per line. An empty list can also mean that the WS code may not read orders. SOAP SiparisServis.SelectSiparisUrun.

tools.name: ticimax_list_order_payments
tools.title: List order payments
tools.description: The payments of one order: type, amount, instalments, bank, approval state and date. An empty list can also mean that the WS code may not read orders. SOAP SiparisServis.SelectSiparisOdeme.

tools.name: ticimax_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: The shipping packages of one order: carrier, tracking number and link, packed products, date. An empty list can also mean that the order has no package yet or that the WS code may not read orders. SOAP SiparisServis.SelectSiparisKargoPaket.

tools.name: ticimax_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: The store's order status names and numbers (the values behind order_status). SOAP SiparisServis.SelectSiparisDurumlari.

tools.name: ticimax_list_payment_types
tools.title: List payment types
tools.description: The store's payment type names and numbers (the values behind payment_type). SOAP SiparisServis.SelectOdemeTipleri.

tools.name: ticimax_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: WRITE: move an order forward in the fulfilment flow (the current status is read first; going back, or moving a cancelled, returned or delivered order, is refused): Onaylandi (approved), Paketleniyor (packing), TedarikEdiliyor (being supplied), KargoyaVerildi (shipped; add the tracking number and link) or TeslimEdildi (delivered). Ticimax applies its normal side effects (stock, shipping, customer e-mail only if notify_customer is true). Cancelling, returning, refunding and deleting orders are not offered. SOAP SiparisServis.SetSiparisDurum.

notify_customer.description: Send Ticimax's status e-mail to the customer (default false).

tools.name: ticimax_set_invoice_number
tools.title: Set order invoice number
tools.description: WRITE: record the invoice number of an order (replaces a previous one). SOAP SiparisServis.SetFaturaNo.

tools.name: ticimax_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List or search product cards with their variants (stock code, barcode, price, discounted price, VAT, stock per variant), category, brand, supplier, images and page URL. Marketplace settings and price-group copies are left out and long descriptions are cut. Filter by status, barcode, stock code, category, brand, supplier, discount, stock level and dates. SOAP UrunServis.SelectUrun.

barcode.description: Only the product with this barcode.

stock_code.description: Only the product with this stock code (SKU).

category_id.description: Only products in this category id (see ticimax_list_categories).

brand_id.description: Only products of this brand id (see ticimax_list_brands).

supplier_id.description: Only products of this supplier id (see ticimax_list_suppliers).

product_card_id.description: Only this product card (ID of ticimax_list_products).

featured.description: Only showcase (vitrin) products (true) or the others (false).

min_stock.description: Only products whose total stock is at least this.

max_stock.description: Only products whose total stock is at most this (0 = out of stock).

created_from.description: Products added on or after this date.

created_to.description: Products added up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

updated_from.description: Products edited on or after this date.

updated_to.description: Products edited up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset for the next page.

tools.name: ticimax_count_products
tools.title: Count products
tools.description: How many products match the filters (same filters as ticimax_list_products). SOAP UrunServis.SelectUrunCount.

barcode.description: Only the product with this barcode.

stock_code.description: Only the product with this stock code (SKU).

category_id.description: Only products in this category id (see ticimax_list_categories).

brand_id.description: Only products of this brand id (see ticimax_list_brands).

supplier_id.description: Only products of this supplier id (see ticimax_list_suppliers).

product_card_id.description: Only this product card (ID of ticimax_list_products).

featured.description: Only showcase (vitrin) products (true) or the others (false).

min_stock.description: Only products whose total stock is at least this.

max_stock.description: Only products whose total stock is at most this (0 = out of stock).

created_from.description: Products added on or after this date.

created_to.description: Products added up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

updated_from.description: Products edited on or after this date.

updated_to.description: Products edited up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

tools.name: ticimax_list_variants
tools.title: List product variants (stock and prices)
tools.description: List variants (the sellable units: size, colour...) with stock code, barcode, stock quantity, price, discounted price, VAT and options. Look one up by barcode or stock code, list the variants of a product card, or find recently changed stock. SOAP UrunServis.SelectVaryasyon.

barcode.description: Only the variant with this barcode.

stock_code.description: Only the variant with this stock code (SKU).

product_card_id.description: Only the variants of this product card (ID of ticimax_list_products).

stock_updated_from.description: Only variants whose stock changed on or after this date.

stock_updated_to.description: Only variants whose stock changed up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset for the next page.

tools.name: ticimax_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: The store's product categories (id, parent id, name, page URL, active, sort order), or one category by id. SOAP UrunServis.SelectKategori.

language.description: Language code of the names, e.g. En (default: the store's own).

tools.name: ticimax_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: The store's product brands (id, name, page URL, active), or one brand by id. SOAP UrunServis.SelectMarka.

tools.name: ticimax_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: The store's suppliers (id, name, e-mail, active), or one supplier by id. SOAP UrunServis.SelectTedarikci.

tools.name: ticimax_list_members
tools.title: List members (customers)
tools.description: List the store's registered members (customers): name, e-mail, phone, city, member type, registration and last login date, e-mail/SMS consent. Filter by e-mail, phone, member id, customer code, status, shopping history, city and registration date. Passwords are never returned. An empty list can also mean that the WS code may not read members. Personal data: use only what the task needs. SOAP UyeServis.SelectUyeler.

email.description: Only the member with this e-mail address.

phone.description: Only the member with this phone number.

customer_code.description: Only the member with this customer code (MusteriKodu).

has_ordered.description: Only members who have (true) or have not (false) placed an order.

city_id.description: Only members from this city id (IlID).

registered_from.description: Members registered on or after this date.

registered_to.description: Members registered up to this date (a plain date includes the whole day).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ticimax_list_member_addresses
tools.title: List member addresses
tools.description: The saved delivery/invoice addresses of one member (recipient, address, city, postal code, company and tax details). An empty list can also mean that the WS code may not read members. Personal data: use only what the task needs. SOAP UyeServis.SelectUyeAdres.
